messages.content: Can you move my next gym session, which is event number 456123, to next Thursday at 4:30 PM? Today is monday 2022-10-20

function.name: reschedule_event
function.description: Reschedule an event to a new date or time, specified in ISO-8601 format. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

event_identifier.description: The unique identifier of the event to be rescheduled.
